mechanism: Praziquantel may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing nortriptyline plasma concentrations and anticholinergic/CNS effects; additive CNS depression possible.
action: Monitor for increased tricyclic antidepressant side effects (sedation, anticholinergic symptoms, cardiac effects); consider nortriptyline dose reduction or therapeutic drug monitoring if concurrent use necessary.
